subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 25, 2026
body:
**First, an apology about how this reaches you.**

The newsletter should never have pinged you. Deciding that your phone was worth interrupting is not our call to make, and we made it for you. Sorry.

From today it is simply pushed out. The newsletter posts into the channel and stops there: no mentions, no pings, no push notifications, nothing that lights up your phone. Read it if you want it. Ignore it, and you will never hear about it from us again.

**And one bit of housekeeping we should have caught sooner:** our Atom feed at acreetionos.org/feed.xml quietly stopped updating on August 14 and we did not notice for six weeks. It is fixed and rebuilt — 121 issues, current through today, and now regenerated every six hours so it cannot go stale again.

**Headline:** "This May Be the Best Arch-Based Linux Distro I’ve Ever Used" - AcreetionOS Shines in Recent Review

In a glowing review published on Medium, writer Michael Swengel extols the virtues of AcreetionOS, calling it "the best Arch-based Linux distro I've ever used." The review highlights the distro's ease of use, stability, and commitment to user freedom. With its Cinnamon desktop and focus on privacy, AcreetionOS has been gaining popularity among Linux enthusiasts. Read the full review on Medium.

**Community News:**

* BetaNews has featured AcreetionOS in an article titled "'It just works': AcreetionOS is the easy-to-use alternative to Windows 10/11 -- switch to it now." The article highlights the distro's user-friendly interface and ease of use.
* Phoronix reported on the resignation of a prominent Arch Linux developer after a 10-year run.

**Practical Tip:**

* Did you know that AcreetionOS has a built-in feature to configure Secret Detection in your GitLab CI/CI pipelines? This feature helps ensure the security of your code by detecting potential security vulnerabilities. To enable it, simply create a `.gitlab-ci.yml` file in your repository and configure Secret Detection as needed.

Stay up-to-date with the latest AcreetionOS news and developments by following us on social media or joining our Discord server. Happy hacking!
